name: What is trenchless sewer line repair and how does it work?

mainEntity.name: What is trenchless sewer line repair and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trenchless sewer line repair is a less invasive method compared to traditional excavation. It involves creating one or two small access points to repair or replace the damaged pipe without digging up your entire yard. Common trenchless techniques include pipe bursting, where a new pipe is pulled through the old one, and pipe lining, where a resin-coated liner is inserted and cured to form a new pipe inside the old one. This method often saves landscaping and reduces disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trenchless repair fixes sewer lines with minimal digging, using methods like pipe bursting or lining to repair or replace pipes.
